deprecated_custom_integration.title: The LoJack custom integration is deprecated
deprecated_custom_integration.description:
The LoJack integration has been merged into Home Assistant core and this custom integration is no longer needed.

To migrate:
1. Remove this custom integration from HACS (or delete the `custom_components/lojack` directory manually).
2. Restart Home Assistant.
3. Add the built-in LoJack integration via **Settings → Devices & Services → Add Integration → LoJack**.

Your existing credentials will need to be re-entered once after switching to the core integration.
